rv.q: Stampley has forged a show here that feels entirely alive and in the moment; her entire cast is at once vulnerable, empathetic, warm-centered and so immersed in this writer's vision that you get caught up in the whole thing.
But this production feels like an ensemble effort — everyone from actors to the sound and lighting designers, to the writer and director duo — and they pulled it off together successfully.
Covenant is finely acted — but the pacing needs tightening.
Covenant is beautifully written, beautifully acted, and beautifully told. It lingers long after the lights go down, like a whispered warning you cannot quite forget.
This is a confidently and expertly directed show in a genre that's difficult to pull off even on screen, let alone a stage in a small theatre. It is an accomplishment to be sure.
I highly recommend Covenant , now playing in Goodman's smaller Owen Theatre. It is one of the best stage thrillers I have seen in a long time.

Ms. Stampley's nail-biting production is filled with powerful performances, edge-of-your-seat tension, hair-raising horror, terrifying special effects and a climax that will leave audiences breathless.
COVENANT is well-done! It's one of those exceptional plays that lends itself to an animated discussion post-show and serious contemplation on seeing it again.
The piece is carried with stamina by five juggernaut actors, who breathe life into their characters with compassion and care.
This play needs more time at Goodman. It's a true find.
York Walker has crafted and Malkia Stampley has shaped an excellent, rewatchable thriller.
Stampley's fervent, sure-handed direction and her fiercely committed actors are ideally suited to Walker's 'Covenant.'
Even assuming that you can't read it, I still do recommend you see it.
The Chicago premiere of Covenant is a thrilling example of theatrical spectacle and storytelling at its finest.
It is bold! It is striking! It is powerful!

TLDR: The return of a rising Blues star to a religious small town in Georgia brings rumors and speculation of deals with the devil. The women of the White family and their close friend are affected by seemingly supernatural occurrences when he does and through understanding their deepest secrets, we see their perspectives color their views.
